scope: Qualification window only. Candidates are unreleased builds of the runtime fork's port/native-lanes-on-mainline branch; no product release, profile, manifest, or published artifact changed. The two shipped native releases (v0.2.3-qwen38-4090-durable.1 and v0.2.5-qwen38-3090-beta.1) were never started or modified: each candidate installs into its own lineage state root (qwen38-4090-native, qwen38-3090-native).
question: Do the mainline-built native Windows lanes pass their own lifecycle qualification (tools/qualification/qualify_native.py) end to end, on the hosts, from a clean state?
answer: Not yet. Five blockers in the release path were found, reproduced, fixed, and re-proven by advancing the orchestrator; both lanes now reach the protocol phase. One open runtime invariant defect and one unavailable host remain.

blockers_fixed.symptom: New-Package.ps1 failed: ninfer_bench.exe command failed with exit 2: unknown argument: --version
blockers_fixed.cause: The native package binds every shipped binary to one build identity and asks each for --version. ninfer and ninfer-serve answer; the mainline bench never had the lane branches' --version arm.
blockers_fixed.fix: 03f56e58 bench: report the build identity from ninfer_bench --version
blockers_fixed.class_note: The lane branches carried this arm; it was one of the ~8K lines of drift the mainline port had to re-derive.

blockers_fixed.symptom: scp -q -3 of the 0.6 GB package timed out after 900 s (RTX 3090: builder host to target host); the same-host RTX 4090 copy stalled at zero bytes for 19 minutes.
blockers_fixed.cause: The orchestrator relayed the package through the operator's Mac (scp -3) across two ~120 ms links, and Windows OpenSSH cannot carry bulk between two Windows hosts in either direction (EXP-019).
blockers_fixed.fix: 723fa8b9 qualification: move the package between hosts directly

cross_host.transport: ranged HTTP (scripts/hosts/pscp.py serve/fetch), 16 streams, bearer token, tailnet

measurement.prior_path: scp -3 relay: 297,835,520 of 591,863,254 bytes in 900 s (0.33 MB/s) before the timeout

blockers_fixed.symptom: Protect-StateRoot.ps1: protected state inherits an external DACL: C:\ProgramData\NInferQualification
blockers_fixed.cause: The orchestrator created its staging root with New-Item under ProgramData, so on a host where the qualification parent did not exist yet the parent inherited BUILTIN\Users write access; the installer refuses to create protected state beneath such an ancestor. The RTX 3090 target already had a protected parent from earlier lane runs, so only the RTX 4090 host failed.
blockers_fixed.fix: 34d11a44 qualification: protect the qualification parent and splat the managed install by name

blockers_fixed.symptom: Install-Release.ps1 : A positional parameter cannot be found that accepts argument '-PackagePath'.
blockers_fixed.cause: The managed install passed its arguments as an array splat, which PowerShell binds positionally.

blockers_fixed.symptom: agent_protocol.py: POST /v1/responses returned HTTP 200, expected 400 - the Responses identity conflict was accepted.
blockers_fixed.cause: The probe sends the session credential on X-NInfer-Session alone and requires a header that disagrees with the body's ninfer_session to be refused. The lane branches applied the header on the Responses create route (apply_response_session_identity); mainline applied it only on the bodyless stored-response routes, so a header-scoped create was silently unscoped and the disagreement was ignored.
blockers_fixed.fix: c36f8d98 serve: bind X-NInfer-Session on Responses create
blockers_fixed.regression_test: tests/test_http_error_handler.cpp - header alone binds, agreement kept, absence stays absent, disagreement is invalid_ninfer_identity/400. Compiled and passed in the candidate's focused ctest set on the builder.

host_pool_sizing_rtx4090.question: The 32 GiB RTX 4090 host failed cudaMallocHost on managed start. Which pool has to shrink?
host_pool_sizing_rtx4090.trigger: The managed start reads the 18 GB model artifact through the file cache immediately before launch: sampled during a failing start, Free & Zero Page List fell 13.1 -> 0.0 GB while Standby Cache Reserve grew to 5.2 GB, then the pinned allocation failed. Three hand-launched probes with identical sizing on an idle host (including one as SYSTEM through a scheduled task) started normally, so the sizing alone is not the discriminator - the cache pressure is.

measurements.start: ready in 30 s hand-launched; failed cudaMallocHost on two managed starts

protocol_contract.error: POST /v1/responses returned HTTP 500: materialization source has no resident state

host_pool_sizing_rtx4090.decision: 4447fe93 keeps 24 host state slots on both lanes and halves only the RTX 4090 lane's Host KV pool to 4 GiB (9.2 GB pinned). Host state slots are not a memory dial: the contract needs them.
host_pool_sizing_rtx4090.reading: Startup pressure is the pool size; the protocol contract is bound by the slot count. The two are separate dials and only one of them was ever safe to turn.

open_findings.severity: runtime invariant violation, reproducible in 41 s
open_findings.observation: With 8 host state slots the agent-protocol step that continues a surviving descendant after its parent response is deleted returns HTTP 500 and the server logs 'materialization source has no resident state' (src/targets/qwen3_6/impl/runtime/program_impl.h:4803, a std::logic_error). The guard fires because a continuation slot still Catalogued at the planned generation has zero resident state replicas (device.state_slots == 0 and host.state_slots == 0), so admission planned reuse from a source whose last replica had been evicted.
open_findings.why_it_matters: The guard is an invariant assertion, not a capacity refusal: under host-state pressure the planner and the residency accounting disagree, and a legitimate request fails with a 500 instead of either keeping the source resident, retiring the catalogue entry, or re-materializing from the durable checkpoint the session already has.
open_findings.status: open, not fixed. Contained for the release by carrying 24 slots on both lanes; the defect is capacity-triggered, not configuration-specific.
open_findings.reproduction: Install a native lane candidate, launch its server with --host-state-slots 8, run <release>/bin/qualification/agent_protocol.py against it.
